# DirectoryConstantCanBeUsed

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `DirectoryConstantCanBeUsedInspection`

`dirname(__FILE__)` computes at runtime what the magic constant `__DIR__`
(PHP 5.3+) already provides. Use the constant.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,5} [Before]
<?php
function bootstrap()
{
    $root = dirname(__FILE__);
    require \dirname(__FILE__) . '/config.php';

    $up    = dirname(__FILE__, 2);
    $other = dirname(__FILE__ . '/../lib');
    $paren = dirname((__FILE__));
    $none  = dirname();
    $dyn   = $resolver->dirname(__FILE__);
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function bootstrap()
{
    $root = __DIR__;
    require __DIR__ . '/config.php';

    $up    = dirname(__FILE__, 2);
    $other = dirname(__FILE__ . '/../lib');
    $paren = dirname((__FILE__));
    $none  = dirname();
    $dyn   = $resolver->dirname(__FILE__);
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Replace dirname(__FILE__) with __DIR__.</li>
<li>line 5: Replace dirname(__FILE__) with __DIR__.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DirectoryConstantCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DirectoryConstantCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection DirectoryConstantCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
